original_test_intent: Program the identified board's offline BIOS ROM with an approved image, then restore and power on the board and prove chip verification, target version and normal health.
original_method: A trained operator validates the offline power/isolation state, chip/package, programmer/adapter/pinout/orientation/voltage and image; preserves a pre-read, performs approved erase/program/verify under ESD control, disconnects/restores safely, powers on and collects BIOS Setup plus OS/BMC health evidence.
manual_activity: Trained operator performs offline isolation, physical hookup, ROM read/erase/program/verify, safe disconnect/restoration and power-on; automation supports artifact and post-boot evidence. PI-version UI case is separate.
safety_requirements: Do not connect/disconnect in unsafe state
No auto-retry or hardware PASS claim
engineer_actions: Verify BIOS Setup and own verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The unsafe `dmidecode` revision grep is at most a post-check; it neither performs nor validates ROM programming and also risks code-only contamination with row 367.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain trained-operator offline read/erase/program/verify under exact vendor electrical/isolation controls, then automate only artifact checks and post-power-on version/health evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Offline ROM method, power-on, BIOS/OS checks and 20/20-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record electrical isolation, pre-image hash, programmer settings and full verify result before restoring the board for multi-surface boot evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds chip-level provenance, ESD/electrical controls and recovery proof.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Restores the actual physical write that DeepSeek omitted.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong chip, voltage, isolation or image can damage hardware or brick the board.

project_override_considerations: Project must provide exact offline ROM hardware/software and board-specific procedure; the private version script is post-check only and row-367 PI 1.7 remains separate.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Primary fields consistently require offline ROM programming; the readback script/DeepSeek command are incomplete rather than contradictory, and duplicate row 367 is isolated.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The physical purpose is identifiable; tool, wiring, image, operator, approval and recovery are finite prerequisites. Execution stops instead of guessing any electrical detail.

review_improvement: Restores the physical critical write and defines chip-level electrical, pre-read, verify and recovery evidence absent from DeepSeek.
independent_technical_reasoning: A revision string after boot cannot establish that an offline ROM was correctly programmed. The write is manual but conditionally executable with exact vendor hardware and operator inputs, so DeepSeek YES changes to REQUIRES rather than BLOCKED.
